mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, John Ehlers' Super Passband waveform returning inward through its symmetric fifty-bar RMS envelope on completed four-hour BTC auctions marks a low-lag cycle reversal; follow the re-entry direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when PB crosses strictly above negative RMS after being at or below it; short when PB crosses strictly below positive RMS after being at or above it
mechanism.why_distinct: The passband is a second-order recursion equivalent to the difference of two Ehlers EMA speeds, rejecting both low- and high-frequency components, while its event is scaled by its own trailing RMS energy. It is not a price-average crossover, bounded return/range oscillator, Roofing Filter zero cross, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: energy-scaled bandpass envelope re-entry clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.initialization: after an invalid gap, first two valid PB observations are zero; require 60 uninterrupted observations before source validity
features.rms: square root of mean squared PB over latest 50 uninterrupted observations
features.reentry: current PB strictly crosses above -RMS from <= for long or below +RMS from >= for short
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Ehlers 40/60 Super Passband RMS-envelope re-entry under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no periods, coefficients, RMS window, initialization, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: John F. Ehlers, The Super Passband Filter, TASC July 2016
external_basis.fixed_definition: close input; Period1=40, Period2=60, a1=5/40, a2=5/60; published second-order PB recursion; RMS=sqrt(mean latest 50 PB squared)); inward crossings of -RMS/+RMS
external_basis.selection_use: published defaults, recursion, energy envelope, and example crossing direction only; no incidence or outcomes
